messages:
Marta Ruiz: Heads up - BlueOak Labs says they were charged twice for the April overage: INV-2026-0475 shows charge $1,350 and Stripe shows a duplicate capture of $1,350. Customer provided Stripe txn ids: ch_3Kf7... and ch_3Kf7_dup. They want the duplicate refunded.

Jon Park: Ouch. Can you confirm invoice applied the correct usage? I'll check our billing run.

Marta Ruiz: Usage lines: compute_overage: $1,200, premium-support: $150. Invoice looks fine, duplicate appears to be a double capture on Stripe side.

Jon Park: Confirmed - invoice INV-2026-0475 has one line for $1,350. Stripe shows two successful charges. Looks like webhook replay happened and our retry logic created a second capture. Gonna open a Stripe dispute or issue refund?

Sophie Lin: For duplicate captures tied to one invoice we prefer issuing a refund (not a credit note) so their bank statement is clean. Approve refund for $1,350 to card ending 4242. Please document GL impacts and tag as non-recurring.

Jon Park: Approved by Sophie. Running refund now: 
```
/stripe-refund --txn ch_3Kf7_dup --amount 1350 --reason "duplicate_charge - webhook replay" --metadata invoice=INV-2026-0475
```

billing-bot: Refund initiated REF-5567, amount $1,350, status=processing. Linked to invoice INV-2026-0475 and Stripe txn ch_3Kf7_dup. Ledger note: "refund for duplicate capture; root cause webhook replay; engineering notified".

Jon Park: Notified engineering (cc @eng-infra) to investigate retry logic. Also updated customer's billing portal with refund status.

CS-bot: Customer message logged - BlueOak acknowledged receipt and asked for an official refund memo for their accounting team. Marta, can you send that when REF-5567 completes?

Marta Ruiz: Will do. Also adding internal follow-up: root_cause=webhook_retry, remediation=add idempotency key; ticket ENG-1892 created.

Sophie Lin: Please charge GL 7001 for refunds and tag month=April_2026, audit_code=DUP_REFUND_Apr2026. Keep this thread for the audit trail.

Jon Park: REF-5567 moved to refunded by Stripe. Closing here. Audit tag: duplicate_refund_BLUEOAK_2026_04. Goodwill? Not needed since it was our fault but we refunded full amount.

Marta Ruiz: Customer replied "thanks, we've received refund confirmation". Closing. :white_check_mark:
